description: NaGe₄(PO₄)₃ crystallizes in the trigonal R3c space group. Na is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.54-2.75 Å. There are two inequivalent Ge sites. In the first Ge site, Ge is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All Ge-O bond lengths are 1.96 Å. In the second Ge site, Ge is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Ge-O bond distances ranging from 1.95-1.99 Å. P is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (1.55 Å) and two longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Ge, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ge, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ge and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ge, and one P atom.
